coverage.content: Definitions, all main theorem ranges, offspring hypotheses, KS thresholds, recursive overview
Posterior moment identities, monotonicity, zero-branch conventions, apriori estimates and entry bounds
Weighted polynomial truncation, dependency chain, remainders and full cubic coefficients
Reconstruction barrier, channel-domain admissibility, Gaussian normal approximation and contraction
SBM coupling, finite types, conditional exchangeability, expected overlap and two-point equivalence
References, Lindeberg proof, Gaussian integral certificate, exact independent small-s expansion

independent_checks: P1 exact analytic family and finite depth enumeration; AppendixB Eq135/h exact rational reproduction; 14 floating quadrature checks; Eq15/105 exact coefficient contrast; P3/P4/P6/P7/P8 analytic boundary/repair proofs.
assumptions_checked: offspring nonnegative integer, exact mean d>1
uniform exponential moments vs mere tightness away from zero
channel interval both signs and inaccessible negative KS boundary
near-critical Eq16 and nonzero expansion denominators
conditional message independence and unconditional random-degree centering
PSD singular Gaussian covariance and softmax shift invariance
C3 bounded derivatives and every increment bound in Lindeberg method
Gaussian normalization, positivity, tail and rounding requirements
fixed q,d,depth with n->infty in coupling; finite types; observable conditioning events
external_limits: No complete formal verification of every high-order remainder inequality
External cited reconstruction/contiguity results not independently re-proved
Large-s full certified grid not rebuilt; printed certificate shown unusable and counterevidence retained
Journal PDF not compared; no version equivalence

independent_acceptance_scope.scope: Focused independent acceptance of the existing eight Problems and the report's explicit bookkeeping qualifications in arXiv2212.03362v2. No redundant full review, external theorem reproof, new author-code execution or fresh large-s numerical certificate; no journal VoR equivalence.
